summary: Frontend-only verification of the theme-toggle + overlay-tokenization corrective fix. All 5 in-scope acceptance items PASS. (1) DARK-BY-DEFAULT on a fresh session (localStorage/IndexedDB cleared): welcome, /(auth)/login and post-login Today all render dark — login screen visually near-black #0E0F12, screenshots confirm. (2) LIVE TOGGLE WORKS: Profile tab shows an 'Appearance → Theme' Card with the two OptionGroup pills, testIDs settings-theme-dark and settings-theme-light both present. Tapping 'Light' immediately flips the whole Profile UI to light mode — outer background becomes light ~#F9FAFB, both nested Cards (Theme, Preferences) render pure white ~#FFFFFF, previously white 'PROFILE / APPEARANCE / PREFERENCES / THEME' labels turn dark grey, teal pill 'Metric (kg/cm)' keeps its accent color, Daily-reminder time chips flip from dark-teal-on-black to teal-on-white — no reload required. Tapping 'Dark' immediately switches back to near-black. (3) PERSISTENCE ACROSS RELOAD: with theme set to Light, a full page reload brings the app back in LIGHT mode (AsyncStorage-on-web = IndexedDB key `tf_theme`). Then switching back to Dark + reload comes back Dark (screenshot 8 shows Dark pill active on Profile immediately after reload). Both directions persist correctly. (4) /targets OVERLAY IS THEME-INDEPENDENT: navigated to /targets in both modes; the three render cards (Conservative 80.6 kg / 23%, Expected 78.8 kg / 22.4%, Stretch 75.7 kg / 21.2%) each show weight, body-fat % and a 'what it takes' line ('~X lb/week ... over 20 weeks'). The 'ESTIMATE' pill on every card measured programmatically as parentBg=rgba(0,0,0,0.5) with textColor=rgb(255,255,255) in BOTH light and dark modes — the overlay.scrim + overlay.onImage tokens are correctly NOT branching on theme. (5) /photo INTRO RENDERS in both modes without crashing — 'BASE PHOTO · A guided full-body shot' copy renders, silhouette outline renders (uses overlay.silhouette = teal @ 0.7 derived from accent, theme-independent), and both 'Take a photo' + 'Upload from gallery' CTAs are present. Web browser does not open the live camera viewport as expected (permission-gated); per review-request note this is not a failure. No red screens, no first-party console errors. Only warnings observed: benign expo-notifications 'push token changes not supported on web' (explicitly out of scope) and the react-native-web `pointerEvents` deprecation (third-party).

action_items: None for this scope — theme toggle, dark-default, persistence via tf_theme, and theme-independent overlays are all verified working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts correctly exposes both `palette` (dark) and a derived `lightColors` object, plus a separate `overlay` object whose members (scrim, onImage, cameraBg, silhouette) are NOT branched by scheme — this matches the spec that overlays on top of imagery stay dark regardless of theme.

ThemeContext.tsx correctly reads/writes `tf_theme` via storage util (AsyncStorage on native, IndexedDB on web); default state is 'dark' before the async read resolves, so first-launch paint is always dark even if storage races.
tokens.ts adds `lightColors` alongside `darkColors` via the same `mapColors` function — no new hex literals introduced, single-source rule preserved.

profile.tsx wires `scheme` + `setScheme` from useTheme() into an <OptionGroup testIDPrefix='settings-theme' /> — this correctly produces `settings-theme-dark` and `settings-theme-light` testIDs (confirmed in DOM).
Confirmed no deprecated Expo modules re-introduced in this iteration; expo-av is still absent, camera flow uses expo-camera equivalent path in /photo.

Minor (non-blocking, carried from iteration_2): raw numeric literals `gap:12/6` in plan.tsx and `width:44,height:40` in (tabs)/index.tsx are still outside spacing tokens. Not a correctness issue and out of this iteration's scope.
